test_positive_subset_rule.interpretation: Subset rule is fundamental effect subtyping: smaller effect set is subtype

test_positive_transitivity.interpretation: Effect subtyping forms partial order; transitivity holds

test_positive_bottom_type.description: cvc5 SAT: bottom type {} (empty effect set) is subtype of all sets
test_positive_bottom_type.interpretation: Empty effect set (pure computation) is subtype of all effect types

test_negative_cyclic_subtyping.description: cvc5 UNSAT: A<B AND B<A (cyclic subtyping) is impossible (subtyping is acyclic order)
test_negative_cyclic_subtyping.reason: Effect subtyping must form partial order; cycles forbidden by antisymmetry

test_negative_antisymmetry_violated.description: cvc5 UNSAT: A⊆B AND B⊆A AND A≠B is impossible (antisymmetry holds)
test_negative_antisymmetry_violated.reason: Mutual subtyping implies equality; partial order antisymmetry is axiomatic

test_negative_non_transitive.description: cvc5 UNSAT: {read}⊆{write,throw} is impossible (disjoint sets cannot satisfy subset)
test_negative_non_transitive.reason: Non-transitive chain contradicts subset definition; transitivity is forced

test_boundary_singleton_subtype.description: cvc5 SAT: singleton effect {read} ⊆ two-element {read, write}
test_boundary_singleton_subtype.interpretation: Singleton effects form subtype of any superset

test_boundary_reflexivity.interpretation: Every effect set is subtype of itself; reflexivity holds

test_boundary_lattice_join.interpretation: Effect subtyping forms lattice; join is union of effect sets
